items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: He quit Horace Hyde to come back home, you see, so his mother could keep him on a strict diet.

ctx.x: He was playing the Sharky's arms. He just passed out right after he ate or something like that.

He had a bad heart. Like Fazola knew he was going to die too. He quit the, what's the band now? The band had the amateur thing that Al Hurt played on. What was the band? Horace Hyde. Horace Hyde. He quit Horace Hyde to come back home, you see, so his mother could keep him on a strict diet. Well he'd eat the diet at home and come out and go to some restaurant and eat a big meal. You see, Fazola didn't die from drinking, he died from eating. He had a bad condition and he was, you know, supposed to be on a strict…
That's what the hell is saying. Everybody says it.
